value.rationale: The exact graph-prism fixed-space reduction is natural, uniform over arbitrary finite base graphs and all robustness thresholds. It yields the complete edge-independent simplex-skeleton classification for all bipartite bases, with explicit integral homology in an unbounded parameter family. For two-row grids it exhibits a dimension-changing but rank-preserving Smith-equality case; the nonbipartite triangle shows a sharp structural boundary. This is geometric/topological information not recoverable from ambient Betti counts or alternating character data.
